title: Kicked-Up Portuguese Wrap
description: A delicious wrap filled with roasted chicken, peas, and spices. Perfect for a quick lunch or snack.
instructions: Preheat your grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill the chicken breast for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the wrap on the grill for 1-2 minutes, or until slightly charred.
Slice the roasted red pepper and set aside.
Add the peas to the wrap, followed by the sliced chicken, roasted red pepper, and chopped cilantro.
Drizzle with kicked-up sauce (if using) and serve immediately.
